logic.entry: At fixed dataset day indexL-1 seed KAMA with the arithmetic mean of closes0..L-1. For j>=L,ER_j=abs(C_j-C_(j-L))/sum(k=j-L+1..j,abs(C_k-C_(k-1)));zero denominator meansER=0. SC_j=[ER_j*(2/(fast+1)-2/(slow+1))+2/(slow+1)]^2. KAMA_j=KAMA_(j-1)+SC_j*(C_j-KAMA_(j-1)),Decimal28. Fast=2. No OOS/fold resets. When flat, enter iff completed close>KAMA*1.01; strict boundary, no prior-cross requirement.
logic.exit: While long, exit iff completed close<KAMA*0.99; equality and inside-band preserve actual held/cash state. No future inputs, fold reset, short position, hold cap or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

sources.scope: Primary platform documentation for unsigned efficiency ratio, squared adaptive smoothing, SMA initialization and optional price filters. Our exact seed indices, slow-period grid and symmetric one-percent rules are specified independently, without claiming profitability.
Official spot filter definitions; historical filters unavailable.
